headline: Target Stock at 52-Week High: Buy, Sell or Hold?
summary: Target has surged 50% this year on the back of one standout quarter, but the analyst consensus now sits below the stock price and the consumer backdrop looks shakier by the month. Before you make a move, the full picture is more complicated than the rally suggests.

headline: Why Target (TGT) Stock Is Trading Up Today
summary: Shares of general merchandise retailer Target (NYSE:TGT) jumped 3.1% in the afternoon session after continued momentum fueled by positive analyst sentiment and a broader market shift toward consumer staples.
